# BuildMeasure

> Reference-backed construction and DIY calculators with transparent formulas, visible assumptions, and metric and imperial inputs.

Canonical site: https://buildmeasure.buildtools.workers.dev/
Maintainer: Hosyss — https://github.com/Hosyss
Source and verified releases: https://github.com/Hosyss/buildmeasure

## Calculators

- [Concrete Calculator](https://buildmeasure.buildtools.workers.dev/concrete-calculator): rectangular slab volume, waste allowance, cubic yards, cubic meters, and 40/60/80 lb bag estimates.
- [Post Hole Concrete Calculator](https://buildmeasure.buildtools.workers.dev/post-hole-concrete-calculator): round-hole concrete volume, multiple holes, optional round or square post displacement, allowance, and 40/60/80 lb bag estimates.
- [Paint Calculator](https://buildmeasure.buildtools.workers.dev/paint-calculator): walls, ceilings, measured openings, coats, coverage, and complete containers.
- [Tile Calculator](https://buildmeasure.buildtools.workers.dev/tile-calculator): area, waste, tile layout, full boxes, and purchase quantity.
- [Gravel Calculator](https://buildmeasure.buildtools.workers.dev/gravel-calculator): volume, adjustable density, weight, tons, tonnes, and complete bags.
- [Mulch Calculator](https://buildmeasure.buildtools.workers.dev/mulch-calculator): bed volume, installed depth, package volume, and complete bags.

## Usage note

BuildMeasure produces planning estimates, not structural, regulatory, contractual, or supplier approval. Verify dimensions, product data, waste assumptions, local requirements, and purchase quantities before construction or ordering.
